T4_obligation.proven_content: NO LONGER VACUOUS as of the R0-R5 ladder (spec/t4-obligation-design-2026-07.md). Previously pendingObligations was provably the constant [] (pendingObligations_eq_nil), so the ~180-line induction quantified over an empty list. R1-R3 added Term.boxed, the obligation-carrying introduction form -- Deriv.boxI had concluded at Term.app, so obligations never inhabited syntax. R4 added discharge-beta, a redex that DESTROYS a box. R5 gave pendingObligations its base case, so a box contributes its own obligation. pendingObligations_eq_nil is now FALSE and deleted; pendingObligations_ne_nil refutes it. Witness DLC/Witness/T4.lean exhibits a term with obligation list [Ow] (impossible before this ladder), a discharge-beta step that REMOVES it, and T4 applied to that concrete step -- so the theorem is exercised on a rule that can fire and a list that can be non-empty.

_dlcd_comment: DLC-D (distributed) headline guarantees. Each is a top-level, machine-checked DLCD.* theorem re-exported by DLCD/Summary.lean and axiom-snapshotted in lean/expected-axioms/dlcd-*.txt (all within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). status=proven means the theorem is fully proved AS STATED about the DLC-D model; the notes record the SCOPE FENCES (what the model does and does not cover). The joint non-vacuity witness is DLCD/Witness.lean's SliceWitness.dlc_d_slice_witness — one inhabited bundle on a single real 2-replica execution simultaneously satisfying G1-G4.

DLCD_capability_safety.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime — a guarantee about the Lean model, not dlc-verifier's Rust at run time; (2) saysI-on-CDeriv — the CARVe-migrated CDeriv judgment does not yet carry the signed says credential the capability layer uses.

DLCD_capability_safety_by_inversion.proven_content: capability_safety_by_inversion (G1, authority, TYPING-NATIVE twin of capability_safety): from the TYPE of a commit-I-typed Term.command M c l (DLC.Deriv.commitI), recover a genuine says-credential derivation for its credential subterm c. Authorization is EXTRACTED by inverting the command's own typing (a generation/inversion lemma, TAPL 13.5), not audited out-of-band. The generation lemma command_typing_inversion is proved by induction on the derivation over a generalized subject: the ~26 rigid-headed rules are discharged by Term.noConfusion, withinE by a type-shape contradiction from the IH (within != replicated), weakenA genuinely by re-applying weakening to the recovered premises. Bridges to the audited Authorized: authorized_of_command_typing (typing -> Authorized, credential TERM is the witness) and authorized_of_commandRealizes (CommandRealizes -> Authorized) proved clean; the realization builder commandRealizes_of_premises (credential + transformer in a shared linear-free context -> CommandRealizes) proved clean. Anti-vacuity: CapSafetyByInversionAntiVacuity builds a concrete commit-I-typed command from the real signed credential saysWitness + an identity transformer, and recovers its credential by inversion.
DLCD_capability_safety_by_inversion.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime. (2) FENCED BRIDGE DIRECTION: the FULL converse Authorized rc issuer -> exists a realizing commit-I-typeable command does NOT close cleanly and is NOT claimed — Authorized's credential derivation lives in an ARBITRARY context (its linear part may be non-empty) whereas commit-I demands a shared linear-free context, AND Authorized carries no store transformer M : phi => phi (commit-I's second premise), neither synthesizable from the credential alone (the cap-prop <-> cred-term / representation gap). The converse is closed exactly when those two data are supplied (commandRealizes_of_premises). (3) issuer/capProp are recovered EXISTENTIALLY (commit-I's conclusion Replicated (phi=>phi) l omits them), matching the exists-issuer shape of capability_safety. Governed capability_safety (the audited WellFormedLog metatheorem) is UNCHANGED, byte-identical; this entry is the additive typing-native re-founding underneath it.

DLCD_capability_safety_linear.proven_content: capability_safety_linear (G1, authority, LINEAR layer): every command in a WellFormedLogL carries a genuine CDerivS (issuer says capProp) linear signed credential — the CARVe/CDeriv-native twin of capability_safety.

DLCD_byz_agreement.proven_content: byz_agreement (fault-model extension): single-decree agreement under <= f BYZANTINE faults with n >= 3f+1 — a >2n/3 Byzantine quorum plus the honest-intersection lemma (any two Byzantine quorums share a non-faulty replica) forces at most one certified value. Consensus.lean (crash-fault) untouched.
DLCD_byz_agreement.note: ByzDecided constrains only HONEST quorum members (Byzantine members equivocate, unconstrained) — the faithful Byzantine-quorum model, which is what makes the honest-intersection (the r-not-in-B) load-bearing. Right-reason bite: a crash-majority (2*card>n) quorum FAILS under Byzantine faults (two majorities can intersect only in the faulty node). SCOPE FENCES: single-decree SAFETY only.

DLCD_budgeted_guarantee_voids_over_budge.proven_content: budgeted_guarantee_voids_over_budget (R1 stageE-E1, the TYPE-LEVEL FAILURE-BUDGET CONTRACT via a graded comonad over the guarantee, design option c'): FaultGrade := Nat is the distilled 1-D consumable crash-fault grade (zero/saturatingAdd/le; grade laws identity+associativity+monotone, associativity DERIVED from Graded.lean's DLC.dp_budget_saturating_add_assoc through the toDpBudget monoid embedding = the delta=0 projection of Graded<DpBudget>). BudgetedGuarantee f b G : Prop delivers the raw guarantee G at grade b under the tolerated bound f, with charged : b <= f the graded counit's availability side and a counit extract : BudgetedGuarantee f b G -> G. THE HEADLINE: at the over-budget grade f (+) 1 the type is GENUINELY UNINHABITED for EVERY payload G (its charged field f+1 <= f is empty) — crossing the fault budget makes the guarantee TYPE void, not a Prop you merely fail to supply. This is the graded-comonad counit's unavailability off-budget (RBTT/Granule), NOT a Prop'/CDeriv term modality (options a/b, rejected as vacuous) and NOT a CARVe resource dimension: the calculus is untouched (no Prop'/CDeriv constructor, no redex, no LRel clause), so SR/NI/progress and the 49 axiom snapshots are byte-identical. Bridge (additive, FailureBudget unmodified): FailureBudget.toFaultGrade := consumed (the grade); FailureBudget.threshold := consumed <= maxFaults (the mislabeled FailureBudget.le clarified as the THRESHOLD guard, not the grade preorder — Atkey LICS'18 keeps them apart); withinContract_iff : withinContract = true <-> threshold /\ fairDelivery; budgetedGuarantee_of_withinContract feeds a within-contract runtime budget into the graded guarantee's charged field. Anti-vacuity: (in-budget) budgeted_converge : BudgetedGuarantee 1 0 (r1.store = pair(var0,var0) /\ r1.store != init) on the real RsmAntiVacuity 2-replica run whose extract FIRES and yields the genuinely CHANGED converged store (a non-trivial Prop, not True); (over-budget) over_budget_refutation : NOT BudgetedGuarantee 0 1 ConvergedPayload — the concrete f=0,b=1 void is REAL (not vacuously true the other way). budgeted_guarantee_voids_over_budget is axiom-free (does not depend on any axioms).
DLCD_budgeted_guarantee_voids_over_budge.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime — a guarantee about the Lean model, not dlc-verifier's Rust. (2) PURELY ADDITIVE E1: touches only the new DLCD/FaultGrade.lean + governance + Summary re-export; NO existing guarantee/theorem is modified; Rsm.FailureBudget (withinContract/le/zero/saturatingAdd) is BYTE-IDENTICAL (the bridge toFaultGrade/threshold is an additive appendage in the same namespace, in FaultGrade.lean). (3) The 2 liveness re-foundings (command_eventually_written(_weakfair) delivered AT a grade, originals kept as extract corollaries) are the SEPARATE E2 increment — not this one. (4) 1-D grade with fairness kept SEPARATE (design ruling; the 2-D (faults,fairness) alternative was declined). (5) Aeneas untouched: FailureBudget/FaultGrade have no dlc-core Rust mirror (graded.rs mirrors DpBudget only); a Rust FaultGrade mirror is DEFERRED (model-side grade).
open: optional Rust FaultGrade mirror in dlc-core (deferred; the grade is model-side and has no operational event charging it in dlc-core)

DLCD_command_eventually_written_budgeted.proven_content: command_eventually_written_budgeted (R1 stageE-E2, the REAL liveness guarantee PACKAGED behind the fault-threshold): an ADDITIVE graded wrapper delivering the Phase-1.2c liveness metatheorem command_eventually_written's EXACT conclusion ((exists k, Decided (run k) c) AND (exists m, applied = i+1 AND store = applyCommand c (applyPrefix init (log.take i)) AND AppliedPrefix ...)) AT a fault grade as BudgetedGuarantee budget.maxFaults budget.consumed G. The original's withinContract = true hypothesis is SPLIT (via FailureBudget.withinContract_iff) into the THRESHOLD budget.consumed <= budget.maxFaults (the graded counit's availability side = the charged field, Atkey LICS'18 keeps threshold separate from the grade preorder) and FAIR DELIVERY budget.fairDelivery = true (the qualitative liveness premise). Over budget (consumed > maxFaults) the charged field consumed <= maxFaults is uninhabitable, so the whole BudgetedGuarantee type is EMPTY for the real liveness G — the eventual-decision guarantee is type-level-unavailable off-budget (the E1 headline budgeted_guarantee_voids_over_budget instantiated on the actual liveness payload). The ENGINE is the ORIGINAL command_eventually_written applied VERBATIM (byte-identical, not re-proved or weakened) after withinContract_iff re-assembles its withinContract premise from the split parts. command_eventually_written_budgeted_extract confirms the counit BudgetedGuarantee.extract recovers G_T exactly (the graded form loses nothing within budget). Boundary witness (DLCD/Witness.lean, on the real 2-replica run at budget = FailureBudget.zero 1, maxFaults=1/consumed=0): write_live_budgeted : BudgetedGuarantee 1 0 (write_live's conclusion) FIRES at grade 0 <= 1, write_live_budgeted_fires recovers write_live verbatim by extract, and write_live_over_budget_void : NOT BudgetedGuarantee 1 2 (write_live's conclusion) instantiates the void on the concrete liveness payload. Non-vacuous both ways.
DLCD_command_eventually_written_budgeted.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime — a guarantee about the Lean model, not dlc-verifier's Rust. (2) PURELY ADDITIVE E2: the original command_eventually_written statement AND proof are BYTE-IDENTICAL (git-diff shows only appended graded wrappers; 0 lines removed from its body); the wrapper only re-packages the conclusion. No core DLC calculus, Rsm.lean def, or other guarantee is modified; Rsm.FailureBudget is byte-identical. (3) The charged field genuinely gates on consumed <= maxFaults (unconstructible over budget), not a True/renamed hypothesis. (4) fairDelivery kept SEPARATE from the grade (design ruling; the FLP-forced fairness premise stays qualitative). (5) Aeneas untouched: no dlc-core Rust change.

The clean converse builder commandTyped_of_wellTypedCmd_premises shows the SAME PropDeriv transformer obligation a well-typed command carries builds commit-I's transformer premise (via propDeriv_to_deriv) and heads a commit-I-typeable command. The log bridge wellTypedLog_of_forall folds a log of WellTypedCmd entries into WellTypedLog, so a log of commit-I-typed commands discharges 2.d's htyped via wellTypedLog_implies_htyped. Anti-vacuity: CommitITypedLogWitness builds a concrete empty-context commit-I derivation (identity transformer guarded by a closed signed now-credential issuer says top), inverts its TYPE to a real WellTypedCmd, and closes the full chain commit-I typing -> WellTypedCmd -> WellTypedLog -> htyped on [wrapper].

The embedding propDeriv_to_deriv : PropDeriv -> Deriv is ONE-DIRECTIONAL (Deriv has weakenA/varL/commitI/... with no PropDeriv image), so wellTypedCmd_of_command_typing takes the fragment witness dMfrag as a SUPPLIED input rather than converting it down from the inverted Deriv premise; the builder direction (commandTyped_of_wellTypedCmd_premises) needs no fence since PropDeriv -> Deriv is total. This mirrors inc4a's fenced converse (Authorized -> CommandRealizes needs data commit-I does not supply). (3) issuer/capProp are recovered EXISTENTIALLY (commit-I's conclusion Replicated (phi=>phi) l omits them). Governed wellTypedLog_implies_htyped / worldStep_preserves_low_typed (the 2.h admission gate) are UNCHANGED, byte-identical; this entry is the additive typing-native re-founding of their WellTypedCmd premise.
